falsification_logic.caveat: A final falsification needs measured grain-size labels; v3 reports falsification_pressure for the public subset.
falsification_logic.confirm_like: Boundary/grain-classified samples show low-T κ exponents clustering near 1/2 and fixed T^0.5 wins against T^1/T^2/T^3 baselines.
falsification_logic.falsify_like: Boundary/grain-classified samples do not show any T^1/2-like envelope.

fixed_exponent_falsification_protocol_v1.falsify_like_rule: In the decisive measured-grain/nanocrystalline subset, T^0.5 loses to T^1/T^2/T^3/free-alpha by AIC/BIC and median alpha is not near 0.5.

MAT3a_broad_material_claim.interpretation: Broad low-T T^1/2 claim is kept separate from nanostructure-only subclaim.

decisive_gate.interpretation_rule: Only decisive_ready=true can be used for confirm/falsify language. Otherwise report plausibility/null pressure only.

mat3_split_claim_v18.recommended_reporting: Report MAT3a as broad null/pressure while preserving MAT3b as an open nanostructure-only positive path tied to T31 grain/nano evidence.

mat3a_mat3b_verdict_v19.positive_link_to_T31: If T31 grain/nano decisive subset expands and stays CCDR-favorable, MAT3b becomes the materials-positive subclaim instead of the broad MAT3a claim.
